caseName: Board of Education of the Hendrick Hudson Central School District v. Rowley
caseNameFull: Board of Education of the Hendrick Hudson Central School District, Westchester County v. Rowley, by her parents, Rowley et ux.

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. [Certiorari granted, 454 U. S. 961.] Motion of respondents to permit interpretation of oral argument granted. Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted.
